attribution: Gao, J., Wang, Z., & Wang, C. (2022). 3D Printing Concrete Mix Design Open Dataset (v0.3) [Dataset]. University of Florida. Zenodo. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.6828947. CC BY 4.0.
storage_medium: single flat table (.xlsx), one row per mix, constituents on a ratio-to-binder basis (binder = 1)
rows_in_source: extrusion-3DCP mixes standardized from many primary studies

fidelity.method: hand-curated ratio-to-binder excerpt; constituent mass-% not formed (no kg/m³ binder content); automated open3dcp-ingest score pending a ratio-to-binder reader (follow-up)

build_cmd: python build/extract.py <3D concrete printing mix design dataset v0.3.xlsx downloaded from the DOI>
